reason: 一次本文を確認したが、既存系統との関連またはLLM推論効率への効果が弱い/間接的で、追加の具体的検証が必要なためborderlineに残す。 This position paper surveys multi-LLM collaboration across API/text/logit/weight levels and discusses cost-aware model selection and cascade tradeoffs. It contributes taxonomy and directions, not a new measured routing/serving algorithm; API cascades can add cost/latency.
title: When One LLM Drools, Multi-LLM Collaboration Rules
